6.21 rsDataRegionInDetailList
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsDataRegionInDetailList is a critical error that will occur when a Table, List, Matrix, Chart, or
Subreport element exists within a List element that does not have List.Grouping specified.
